name: Permafrost

parts.label: Passive - Frostbrand
parts.text:
Passive - Frostbrand: Winter's Wrath and both Sejuani's and nearby allied melee champions' basic attacks on-hit apply stacks of Frost to enemy champions, medium or large monsters, and large minions for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 4 times, though not applying if the target is Frozen. Enemies hit by Permafrost or Glacial Prison bola have all of their Frost stacks consumed. Enemy champions cannot be affected by Frost for 8 seconds after having it consumed.

Sejuani can cast Permafrost against an enemy with 4 stacks.

mechanics.evidence: Passive - Frostbrand: Winter's Wrath and both Sejuani's and nearby allied melee champions' basic attacks on-hit apply stacks of Frost to enemy champions, medium or large monsters, and large minions for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 4 times, though not applying if the target is Frozen.

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Sejuani hurls a trap at the visible enemy with 4 stacks of Frost closest to the cursor, which deals magic damage, displaces them slightly, and stuns them for 1 second.

mechanics.evidence: Active: Sejuani hurls a trap at the visible enemy with 4 stacks of Frost closest to the cursor, which deals magic damage, displaces them slightly, and stuns them for 1 second.
Active: Sejuani hurls a trap at the visible enemy with 4 stacks of Frost closest to the cursor, which deals magic damage, displaces them slightly, and stuns them for 1 second.

tips.tip: Does not apply airborne nor is a knockdown. Applies a move block (forced movement) which can interrupt dashes and other displacements.

parts.text: Permafrost resets Sejuani's basic attack timer.

mechanics.evidence: Permafrost resets Sejuani's basic attack timer.

notes: Permafrost's targeting prioritizes champions within 50 units of the cursor's selection, then non-champions within 50 units of the cursor's selection, then champions within 350 units of the cursor's selection, then the closest unit to the cursor within 2500 units (the last case strictly applies if there is no target being selected).
Frost stacks will not be applied if the basic attack is blocked.
: Permafrost's stack application interaction with parrying effects (dodge, blind).
Alpha Strike does not interact with Permafrost.
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but still go on cooldown and pay its cost.

name: Fury of the North

parts.label: Innate - Icebreaker
parts.text: Innate - Icebreaker: Enemies stunned by Sejuani are marked Frozen for the disable's duration. Sejuani's next basic attack or ability against a Frozen enemy will consume the mark to deal bonus magic damage equal to 10% of their maximum health, capped at 250 against epic monsters.

mechanics.evidence: Innate - Icebreaker: Enemies stunned by Sejuani are marked Frozen for the disable's duration.

parts.label: Innate - Frost Armor
parts.text: Innate - Frost Armor: Sejuani gains Frost Armor, which lingers for 3 seconds after taking damage from enemy champions, turrets, or large monsters. She restores it after 12 – 6 (based on level) seconds without taking damage from them.

values.context: She restores it after 12 – 6 (based on level) seconds without taking damage from them.

parts.label: Frost Armor
parts.text: Frost Armor: Sejuani gains slow immunity, cripple immunity, 10 (+ 75% bonus armor) bonus armor, and 10 (+ 75% bonus magic resistance) bonus magic resistance.

mechanics.evidence: Frost Armor: Sejuani gains slow immunity, cripple immunity, 10 (+ 75% bonus armor) bonus armor, and 10 (+ 75% bonus magic resistance) bonus magic resistance.

notes: Gaining Frost Armor does not remove any pre-existing slows or cripples.
Icebreaker will not trigger if the basic attack is blocked or misses due to blind.

name: Arctic Assault

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Bristle dashes to the target location until he collides with an enemy champion, dealing magic damage to enemies he passes through and knocking them up for 0.5 seconds.

mechanics.evidence: Active: Bristle dashes to the target location until he collides with an enemy champion, dealing magic damage to enemies he passes through and knocking them up for 0.5 seconds.
Active: Bristle dashes to the target location until he collides with an enemy champion, dealing magic damage to enemies he passes through and knocking them up for 0.5 seconds.

parts.text: Arctic Assault can be cast during her other abilities without cancelling them and vice versa.

notes: Arctic Assault has no minimum dash range.
Champions will be slightly knocked back, while minions and monsters will instead be slightly pulled for a fixed distance. Neither can displace through terrain.
Casting Flash during Arctic Assault will end the dash and affect enemies at the new location.
If the dash collides with an enemy champion, Sejuani will be ordered to basic attack them.
